note: Per-election alliance records read from the English Wikipedia election pages listed in each record's sources on 2026-11-22. Only pre-poll arrangements named on those pages are recorded; elections with no cited record have no entry and the UI shows no grouping (never invent). 'pre-poll' = announced before polling; 'post-hoc' = analytic grouping applied in hindsight and must be labelled as such in the UI. Wikipedia is a secondary source: confidence 'high' means the page states the alliance and members unambiguously, 'medium' means the page is ambiguous about scope or membership. Not covered: Lok Sabha 2014 (no data in elections.json), Telangana Lok Sabha 2019 and 2024 (the pages name no state-level alliance).

groups.name: NDA (TDP+BJP)
groups.note: Janasena (founded March 2014) campaigned in support but did not contest; it is not listed as a member.

comparabilityNotes: 2014 was the first assembly election for residual Andhra Pradesh (175 seats) after bifurcation; the same-day election page also covers Telangana.

groups.name: JSP+ (JSP+BSP+CPI+CPM)
groups.note: TDP, YSRCP, INC and BJP contested without any alliance (TDP had left the NDA in March 2018).

groups.name: Hindsight: 2024 NDA parties (TDP+JSP+BJP)
groups.note: These parties did NOT contest 2019 as an alliance; the grouping re-aggregates 2019 results under the 2024 alliance for comparison only.
